what: The survey tool error models of the ISCWSA's Operator Wellbore Survey Group (OWSG) tool-code sets A and B, Rev 5.1 (2020-10-08), that use only the ISCWSA MWD Rev 5 weighting functions: each model's error terms, magnitudes, units and propagation modes. The AX (axial-interference corrected), gyroscopic, film, dipmeter, inclination-only and blind models are not carried: their terms use weighting functions this program does not implement.
source: ISCWSA / OWSG tool-code workbooks (toolgroup-owsg-a-rev-5-1-08-oct-2020-produced-23-sep-2022.xlsx, toolgroup-owsg-b-rev-5-1-08-oct-2020-produced-23-sep-2022.xlsx), as converted to the ISCWSA JSON tool-model schema in welleng (github.com/jonnymaserati/welleng, welleng/errors/iscwsa_json, version 0.29.1 on PyPI, Copyright (c) 2023 Jonathan Corcutt).
license: Apache License 2.0 (welleng). The terms' names, values, units and propagation modes are copied unchanged; the weighting formulas are not copied (they are the ISCWSA Rev 5 functions, implemented in gea/wellpos.py and checked against the ISCWSA's own example).

propagation.Systematic: the same error through one survey run
propagation.Well: the same error through one well, independent between wells
propagation.Global: the same error in every well of the field
